title: Pastel grainy background, calmer motion, no corner-growing panels
changes: The tab background is a soft pastel of the tab colour with a fine, static film grain
Panel transitions no longer morph size and position, which made the data panel's items appear to grow from different corners
Panel motion is shorter and gentler: 10px out, 14px in, no overshoot; the colour push is 0.8s without a bounce
The always-running header line and the logo sheen are switched off to reduce clutter
